The role

We help investors approach UAE opportunities with clearer information, realistic assumptions and the right local support.

Our value is not the promotion of a particular property or product. It is the ability to help an investor navigate the market, ask the right commercial questions and assemble the appropriate licensed team around the opportunity, then keep the wider commercial objective in view while they do their work.

ResidentialCommercialMixed-useHospitality-led

Who we work with

Private investors

Individuals and family offices exploring residential, commercial or mixed-use opportunities in the UAE.

Business owners

Establishing, expanding or relocating an operation, and the premises it needs.

International partners

Entering the market and needing a local point of contact who understands how it works.

Owners based abroad

Holding a UAE asset or business and needing independent local oversight.

The principles

Clearer information before the decision.
Realistic assumptions, not a sales case.
The right licensed team around the opportunity.

Brokerage, valuation, legal, tax and regulated financial advice stay with the professionals licensed to give it. Our job is to make sure you have them, and that they are working towards the same objective.

How it fits together
Coordination, not substitution

One point of contact. The right specialists.

Under an agreed mandate, K&K sits between the investor and the people a UAE transaction needs: licensed brokers, developers, legal advisers, banks, tax advisers, valuers, technical consultants and property managers. We make the introductions, coordinate the work and keep the questions moving, while regulated work stays with regulated professionals.

01

Orientation & screening

Clarifying your objectives, time horizon, preferred sectors or property types, budget and risk considerations, with an introduction to the relevant UAE market and operating context. Then an initial commercial review of what is being presented: location, positioning, sponsor or developer, demand assumptions, proposed terms and the evident risks.

02

Commercial assessment

Financial assumptions, cash requirements, operating considerations and scenario comparisons, so the commercial logic behind an opportunity is understood before money moves. Formal valuation, investment advice and regulated financial analysis remain with appointed professionals.

03

Due-diligence coordination

An information checklist, the advisers to answer it and a running view of the commercial, legal, financial and technical questions that matter, so material issues are visible before a decision is taken rather than after.

04

Investor representation

Ongoing coordination on your behalf through evaluation, negotiation support, adviser management and implementation, without undertaking activities reserved for licensed professionals.

05

Post-investment oversight

Periodic commercial reporting, stakeholder coordination and owner representation under an agreed scope, particularly for investors based outside the UAE who need an independent local point of contact.

Hospitality-led

Where property, business operations and destination potential must be considered together, in hotels, food and beverage or mixed-use destinations, the review draws on K&K Hospitality's owner-and-operator perspective. About K&K Hospitality

Dr. Tayeb Kamali

Co-Founder & Chairman
Investment and institutional partnerships

Dr. Kamali brings long-standing UAE leadership across education, applied research, government-related institutions, corporate boards and investment networks. His roles have required the assessment of partnerships, institutional opportunities, technology ventures and long-term strategic initiatives involving both public- and private-sector stakeholders.

That board and investment experience gives K&K senior-level perspective and relationships across the UAE. Combined with the firm's ownership and operating experience, it supports a disciplined approach to assessing opportunities, building partnerships and executing locally.

Mohamed Kamali

Managing Director
Investment and hospitality development

An owner and investor by background, Mohamed leads opportunity assessment, investment strategy and commercial structure at K&K. He was Managing Partner of Unity Consulting for a decade, co-founded VUL9 Security Solutions and remains active in venture capital and angel investment.

Through Kohantei in Dubai and now Abu Dhabi, he also brings an operator's eye to any opportunity where a business, not only a building, is being bought.
